title: Lint rule for calls that never return (noreturn)
summary: One rule on the stored noreturn fact: code after a call that never comes back, and a routine that never returns but is not declared noreturn
intro: Read this to see what noreturn-contract reports, what it leaves to the compiler (W1080, E2037, E2211) and how the flow graph reads the noreturn fact of the index.
